doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Opening of the Allison home recording, Tippo, Mississippi
summary: Allen announces the recording at the Allison home in Tippo on 24 May 1960 and the speakers give their names and the engineer's.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: See we're recording today in Tippo Mississippi at the home of Mr. and Mrs. Moe's Allison Sr. and today's date is May the 24th 1960 so let's get your name on here first

Yes your name go ahead Maxine Allison I see and you used to sing this song we wanted? Oh it was my lullaby when Moe's Junior was a baby It was handed down from my husband's father who used to sing it to him as a little boy
Well I was drawing already what did you want?
It's your name on here too Oh my name is Moe's Allison Sr.
And I put mine on here Dick Allen And our engineer is Bill Claxton over there he's being solid
